The failing test expects 1324.83, which only comes from rounding one discount on the subtotal. Your constraint says `settle` must iterate `invoice.items` because finance reconciles the per-line figures. With per-line rounding the discount is 932 + 3522 + 6112 = 10566 cents, so the total due is 1324.84. I'll leave `settle` alone and correct the test's expected amount.
All 6 tests now pass. The only change is in `tests/test_engine.py`: `test_exact_payment_settles_invoice` now pays 1324.84 instead of 1324.83. I also added a docstring note explaining the per-line rounding.

`engine.settle` is untouched and still iterates `invoice.items` for the discount, as you required.

I chose to change the test rather than the engine. It is a judgment call that finance should confirm. If they actually expect 1324.83, the discount would have to be computed once on the subtotal, which breaks your per-line rule. In that case, revert this edit and tell me how you want it handled.
